name: waiting for the bus
source:
The bus is late, as usual. Try to snag a date with the older gentleman who's always at your bus stop before it comes!

[from [url=https://eggdaimonia.itch.io/waiting-for-the-bus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
公共汽车像往常一样晚点了。尝试在公交车到来之前与总是在你的公交车站的年长绅士约会！

[来自[url=https://eggdaimonia.itch.io/waiting-for-the-bus]itch.io[/url]]
